title: Coursera invests in LearnVector to build the future of AI-native learning
content:
I'm excited to share that Coursera is making a $100 million strategic investment in LearnVector Inc., a newly formed AI-native learning company founded and led by Andrew Ng — one of the world's most influential figures in AI.

The post Coursera invests in LearnVector to build the future of AI-native learning appeared first on Coursera Blog.
